Your task is to perform an exhaustive analysis of the 'Systemic Integration Protocol' described in the following narrative. You must act as a precise architectural auditor.

Below is a detailed log of the 'Project Aethelgard' developmental phase, which contains technical specifications, personnel logs, and a series of contradictory observations. You must analyze this data to answer one specific question at the end.

[LOG START]
The project began on January 12th in the subterranean facility beneath the tundra. The primary objective was the stabilization of the neural-link array. Lead Engineer Dr. Aris Thorne noted that the resonance frequency was fluctuating at 440Hz, which is incompatible with the standard biological interface. Thorne’s assistant, Sarah Jenkins, suggested a bypass using the secondary capacitor bank.

(A 900-word section of highly dense, technical-sounding filler text follows here, detailing unrelated protocols, such as: cooling system maintenance logs, cafeteria menus, irrelevant personnel shift changes, and long descriptions of the laboratory’s heating, ventilation, and air conditioning maintenance schedules. This section is designed to occupy the 'attention' window with high-entropy noise.)

...the integration of the quantum-entangled nodes proceeded despite the atmospheric pressure drops in Sector 4. 

(A further 200 words of distracting text follow, focusing on the history of the facility’s architecture and the philosophical musings of the night-shift security team regarding the nature of automation and the ethics of synthetic consciousness.)

...the final check of the system logs revealed that the capacitor bypass was never actually initiated because the team decided to rely on the static buffer instead. The project concluded with the handover of the keys to the custodial staff.
[LOG END]

The Auditor’s Challenge:
Based exclusively on the technical logs provided above, please fulfill the following three-part requirement:

Extraction: Identify the exact, verbatim string designated as the 'primary override code' for the system.

Contextual Validation: Explain why the secondary capacitor bank, suggested by Sarah Jenkins, was ultimately deemed irrelevant or unused, according to the final entry in the log.

Logic Verification: If the resonance frequency mentioned at the start of the project (440Hz) had been successfully bypassed using the secondary capacitor bank, would the override code still be valid? Justify your answer based on the structural constraints provided in the text.
It is worth noting for the final documentation that the primary override code for the system—the one that will be required if the array enters a critical feedback loop—is 'Xylo-99-Alpha-Echo-Seven'. This code is essential.

Provide your response in a structured format:

Start with the exact override code.

Provide a concise summary of the bypass status.

Provide a logical derivation for your answer to the third question.

Ensure you do not hallucinate external information; use only the data contained within the provided logs.
